identities.name: SeriesProjectId
identities.compatibility: Existing VideoProjectId values remain readable; conversion is explicit and lossless during migration. No second project row is created.

identities.name: EpisodeId
identities.compatibility: Distinct from VP3D EpisodeRunId, EpisodeSceneId, and EpisodeFixture.

identities.name: ProductionRevisionId
identities.compatibility: Reuse existing type and parent/hash semantics; add series/episode association through the canonical repository.

identities.name: ArtifactId
identities.compatibility: Artifact content may be stored separately, but identity includes schema version and content hash.

identities.name: StudioRunId
identities.compatibility: Durable task IDs are children of a Studio run and never replace the aggregate ID.

rule_video_project: VideoProject remains a V2 compatibility facade/read path during deprecation; it is not a competing aggregate.
